description: The kit's shortcuts handler next to Jellyfin Enhanced's B key, in the je sandbox, next to Jellyfin Enhanced with BookmarkCurrentTime = B: on the video page the kit's shortcuts handler fires once for Shift+B (one bookmark, the event defaultPrevented afterwards, no JE modal), never for B (JE's capture listener stops it before the bubble phase; its modal opens; no bookmark), and skips an event that is already defaultPrevented. The probe's recorders are a window capture listener (first of all) and a window bubble listener (last of all), registered at page load, before JE's. Also records JE's OSD bookmark button and JE's active key. je-switchoff-probe.mjs runs it; on its own it needs the sandbox's fixture state (JE Bookmarks on, B).

steps.name: install the key recorder before any page script
steps.initScript: (function () { const events = []; function combo(e) { return (e.shiftKey ? 'Shift+' : '') + (e.metaKey ? 'Meta+' : '') + (e.ctrlKey ? 'Ctrl+' : '') + (e.altKey ? 'Alt+' : '') + (/^[a-zA-Z]$/.test(e.key) ? e.key.toUpperCase() : e.key); } const seen = new WeakMap(); window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { const r = { combo: combo(e), target: (e.target && e.target.tagName) || '', capturePrevented: e.defaultPrevented, bubbleReachedWindow: false, finalPrevented: null, synthetic: !e.isTrusted }; seen.set(e, r); events.push(r); }, true); window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { const r = seen.get(e); if (r) { r.bubbleReachedWindow = true; r.finalPrevented = e.defaultPrevented; } }, false); window.__shortcutKeys = { events: events, last: function (c) { for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (events[i].combo === c) return events[i]; } return null; }, reset: function () { events.length = 0; } }; })();

steps.script: const e = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'B', shiftKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); e.preventDefault(); document.body.dispatchEvent(e); return __shortcutKeys.last('Shift+B');

steps.name: delete the bookmark this check made
steps.script: const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); const mine = list.slice(Number(__vars.before)); for (const b of mine) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id) }); } return mine.length;
